roads.name: Highway 307
words: An easygoing road: 6 curves in 3.5 miles, with room to breathe between them.
From 1 to 2 ft, with 6 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.86 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Gheens Main Road
words: Properly twisty: 29 curves in 3.4 miles, about 9 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 0 to 3 ft, with 12 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.11 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: River Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 12 curves in 3.4 miles.
From 6 to 24 ft, with 58 ft of up and down along the way.
